patches.note: Update 1.05; GLSLC shaders in main. Pool words stand in until pools get 64 KB-aligned GPU addresses. Bloom taps hoist from their guards; split quads take whole-quad LOD.

words.note: Allocates the ring-heap pool's storage with 64 KB of slack instead of 4 KB, so it can start on a 64 KB boundary.
Rounds the storage start up to 64 KB (with the next word): Armigo's pool GPU address is its guest address, which the console driver keeps 64 KB-aligned.
Completes the 64 KB round-up; the engine carves its ring heaps from this pool at 64 KB GPU alignment, sized exactly.
